quality_effect: Separates independent ground-truth QC statistics from parcel elevation uncertainty and preserves survey-age limits.
verified_facts: Points are captured on flat unambiguous surfaces
Attributes include survey date surface type survey method transformation and geoidal model
Ground truth may be reused when less than 5 years old
Coastal projects use a 3-year reuse limit
Timestamped LIDAR is compared against ground truth using RMSE standard deviation and random error
LIDAR surveys must be under +/-15cm RMSE to pass QC
